notes.title: Early Access Release July 25, 2025
notes.notes:
We are officially releasing our Early Access version of the interactive album for Forever Epic Story on  

July 25, 2025! Everyone will receive free updates for the album and all new songs added through Early Access. 

Everyone who purchases will get free access to the online browser version and access to the online community.

Get free access key here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/3531200/discussions/0/546740620659723073/

notes.title: Update: Online Launch Event July 27th 2025
notes.notes:
Our latest game update is being released with our early access launch. We are also having our community launch event on our platform on July 27th 2024. Be sure to join us at the event and chat with the artists, engage in community activities and more. 

*Everyone who purchases the app on Steam can apply for a free access code on our Steam discussion forum. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531200/Forever_Epic_Story_A_Journey_of_Life_Music_Album/

Apply for Free Access Key Here

notes.title: Early Access Release: July 17th 2025
notes.notes:
Forever Epic Story is happy to announce their Early Access launch event on Steam July 17th 2025. The launch will include full access to their interactive album, music downloads, videos and an opportunity to receive free access to their website online launch on July 27th 2025.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531200/Forever_Epic_Story_A_Journey_of_Life_Music_Album/
We are providing Free Access Keys (to our fan community platform) for everyone who purchases the app on Steam. Visit the steam discussions to apply.
Apply for Free Access Key Here

notes.title: Forever Epic Story: Soundtrack Singles Release 5-5-25
notes.notes:
5 Soundtrack singles from the upcoming album "Forever Epic Story - A Journey of Life" will be officially released on Steam 5-5-25. 

*Be sure to wishlist the official interactive album and get the singles now before the official launch of the album! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531200/Forever_Epic_Story_A_Journey_of_Life_Music_Album/

Thank you everyone for your continued support,

Forever Epic Story Team
